description: Wind Knowledge Hub domain schema for wind farm operations and maintenance knowledge.

domains.label: Blade
domains.description: Blade inspection, damage, cracks, leading edge erosion, lightning damage, UAV blade inspection.

domains.label: Gearbox
domains.description: Gearbox oil temperature, bearing faults, gear wear, lubrication, vibration and drivetrain diagnosis.

domains.label: Generator
domains.description: Generator electrical and mechanical health, bearing temperature, insulation, current and vibration issues.

domains.label: Converter
domains.description: Converter, inverter, rectifier, cooling, grid-side and machine-side power electronics.

domains.label: Yaw
domains.description: Yaw drive, yaw motor, yaw bearing, yaw brake and wind alignment issues.

domains.label: Pitch
domains.description: Pitch drive, pitch motor, pitch battery, pitch communication and blade angle control issues.

domains.label: Hydraulic
domains.description: Hydraulic pump, pressure, leakage, brake hydraulic system and oil condition.

domains.label: Tower
domains.description: Tower structure, bolts, welds, corrosion, climbing safety and tower vibration.

domains.label: Foundation
domains.description: Foundation settlement, cracks, anchor bolts, grout and civil structure issues.

domains.label: SCADA
domains.description: SCADA alarms, operating data, wind speed, power curve, temperature, current and voltage trends.

domains.label: Safety
domains.description: Electrical safety, lifting, grid connection, working at height, lockout, fire and human safety rules.

domains.label: Maintenance
domains.description: Maintenance plans, work orders, spare parts, inspection schedules, defect closure and service procedures.
